sources.name: PESEL registry — first names (imiona), living persons
sources.notes: 7,949 unique first names after deduplication and threshold filtering. Embedded in server/pl_gazetteers.py::FIRST_NAMES.

sources.name: PESEL registry — surnames (nazwiska), living persons, male and female forms
sources.notes: 8,636 unique surnames after deduplication. Embedded in server/pl_gazetteers.py::SURNAMES.

sources.name: Wykaz urzędowych nazw miejscowości i ich części (MSWiA / GUS TERYT SIMC)
sources.notes: 69,984 locality names (nominative + genitive forms). All cities, deduplicated villages. Embedded in server/pl_gazetteers.py::LOCALITIES.

sources.name: CSM — hard-negative legal document labels (internal)
sources.notes: ~90 two-token Polish document section headings and form-field labels that must never be masked. Hand-authored from common contract and pleading templates. Stored in server/gazetteers/pl_legal_labels_negative.json.

sources.name: CSM — surnames that are also common Polish nouns (negative evidence sample)
sources.notes: Sample of ~40 Polish words that are valid surnames but also common nouns (mucha, lis, wilk, etc.). Without legal context, these must not trigger PII masking. Stored in server/gazetteers/pl_common_words_negative.sample.json.
